What makes Dark Noon such a rollicking entertainment, though, is Biering’s embrace of 21st-century technology as well as modern devices like audience participation...
Dark Noon is an energetic juggernaut, but one wishes the show had a more discerning eye.
Dark Noon is scattershot, as scenes go on too long and themes repeat, and the livestreaming of the action is overused; with things happening so fast, it’s often hard to know where to look.

cn.t: This South African-Danish deconstruction of Western mythology earns praise for its fresh outsider perspective and visceral energy, but critics split on whether its satirical focus is sharp or scattered across too many themes.
